form a valid FQDN for DNS requests to target. (optional filter)

options.name: vip
options.description:
Assigns an IP to the DNS service. DNS requests from your external DNS server must be delegated to this IP.
(optional filter)

options.name: vip_allocation
options.description: VIP allocation type (optional filter)

options.name: vip_gateway
options.description:
Specifies a gateway IP to external DNS server if on different subnet. Must be on same subnet as the IP and
reachable from the relevant nework interface. (optional filter)

options.name: vip_ipv6
options.description: Assigns an IPv6 to the DNS service. (optional filter)

options.name: vip_ipv6_gateway
options.description: Specifies a gateway IPv6 to external DNS server if on different subnet. (optional filter)

options.name: vip_ipv6_subnet_cidr
options.description: Specifies the subnet, as a CIDR index, on which the DNS resides. [1..128] (optional filter)

options.name: vip_subnet_cidr
options.description: Specifies the subnet, as a CIDR index, on which the DNS resides. (optional filter)

options.name: vip_vlan
options.description: Specifies a VLAN if needed to enable communication with external DNS server(s). (optional filter)
